verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Claude is available on Google Cloud's Agent Platform (Vertex) through an API that is 'nearly identical' to the Messages API. The model-ID docs also reference per-platform ID tables, which implies distribution beyond Anthropic's own endpoint. Only one third-party cloud is explicitly evidenced, though. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Bedrock availability, Azure availability, OpenRouter-class gateway support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-cloud parity.
